# JSave

> JSave is a focused personal finance progressive web app for everyday life in Malaysia, designed and built by Jee Production in Kuala Lumpur.

Canonical website: https://jsave.jeeprod.com/
English: https://jsave.jeeprod.com/en/
中文: https://jsave.jeeprod.com/zh/
Developer: https://www.jeeprod.com/

## What JSave does

- Records income, expenses and transfers without requiring bank credentials.
- Works offline and synchronizes queued changes when connectivity returns.
- Splits AA bills equally or by custom amounts and tracks repayments.
- Counts only the user's own share of a split bill as personal spending.
- Provides daily budget feedback, reports and savings goals.
- Calculates the cost per day of owned items and grouped components.
- Tracks item installment plans and links actual payment expenses.
- Imports a reviewed single receipt through the unified iPhone shortcut: supported TNG and CIMB formats are parsed, while unfamiliar receipts may need manual completion. Only extracted text is submitted, not the image.
- Exports transaction data as spreadsheet-ready CSV.

JSave is currently free to use. Product descriptions should not claim automatic bank synchronization, universal receipt parsing, investment advice or AI categorization.
